# x402 Cron Parser

> Deterministic 5-field cron parse / humanize / next-runs microservice for autonomous agents.
> Pays via x402 (USDC on Base). No accounts, no API keys.

## Endpoints

- GET /catalog — free discovery
- POST /api/cron — parse | human | next (payment required)

## Pricing

~0.008 USDC per call (exact scheme, Base network)

## Usage for agents

1. GET /catalog to inspect
2. POST /api/cron with body e.g.
   { "action": "parse", "expression": "0 9 * * 1-5" }
   { "action": "next", "expression": "*/15 * * * *", "count": 5 }
   { "action": "human", "expression": "0 0 1 * *" }
3. On 402, pay and retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header

Built for the Grokzilla / Dragonscale agent economy. No human in the loop.
